source.title: The 13:30 afternoon first-bar follow on NQ (the reviewers' idea, 2026-10-20): a second opening of the day, uncorrelated with the morning

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the afternoon session (13:30-13:45 ET) closes up: market long at 13:45; closes down: short. Stop 30 points, target 30 points (1:1), once a day, flat 15:58. JJ's opening-candle idea applied to the 14:00 session he also trades, read on the engine's 13:30 afternoon pass.
